pr_title: `ruff server`: Support the usage of tildes and environment variables in `logFile`
pr_body:
## Summary

Fixes #11911.

`shellexpand` is now used on `logFile` to expand the file path, allowing the usage of `~` and environment variables.

## Test Plan

1. Set `logFile` in either Neovim or Helix to a file path that needs expansion, like `~/.config/helix/ruff_logs.txt`.
2. Ensure that `RUFF_TRACE` is set to `messages` or `verbose`
3. Open a Python file in Neovim/Helix
4. Confirm that a file at the path specified was created, with the expected logs.

issue_context.title: The `logFile` language server setting should support shell expansion
issue_context.body:
Follow-up to this review comment: https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff/pull/11883#discussion_r1642235781

We should support shell expansion for `logFile`, which will enable users to use tildes and environment variables in the log file path, similar to how we support this with the `configuration` setting.

review_comments: I think this is worth mentioning in the user facing documentation
